title: Encounter at Farpoint
summary: Captain Picard takes command of the Galaxy Class Federation starship, the ‘Enterprise. Picard not only takes over the ‘Enterprise' but has his first encounter with a extremely powerful life form known as ‘Q' who proceeds to put humanity on trial for their crimes. Q makes their first mission to the Farpoint station on Daneb IV a extreme test for the existence of humanity.

title: Encounter at Farpoint
summary: At the end of the trial, Q gives Captain Picard 24 hours to solve the mystery of Farpoint station and save the human race. Picard and his team come to a unusual conclusion about the problems encountered at the way station in space.

title: The Naked Now
summary: The Enterprise away team is investigating mysterious deaths and Geordi becomes infected with a illness that is mind-altering and starts spreading throughout the rest of the ships crew.

title: Code of Honor
summary: While involved in a treaty discussion with the inhabitants of Ligon II, Tasha is abducted and Picard is forced to abide by the inhabitants Code of Honor to obtain her release.

title: The Last Outpost
summary: Ferengi and Enterprise teams beam down to an unknown world to discover who or what has sapped power from both vessels.

title: Where No One Has Gone Before
summary: Teenager Wesley Crusher and a dying alien are the crew's only hope for escape from a bizarre galaxy where thoughts become real.

title: Lonely Among Us
summary: Passing through a series of complex energy patterns, the Enterprise crew find themselves trying to solve the mystery surrounding the death of Assistant Chief Engineer Singh and the altered personalities of Lt. Worf, Dr. Crusher and the Captain.

title: Justice
summary: To learn the origin of a mysterious ship, Picard must get help from a planet where Wesley faces a death sentence.

title: The Battle
summary: A vengeful Ferengi captain returns Picard's long-lost ship, the Stargazer, after installing a mind-altering device.

title: Hide and Q
summary: Q gives the powers of the Q to Riker and tells him his shipmates wishes will be granted if he joins with those of the Q Continuum.

title: Haven
summary: Counselor Troi faces an arranged marriage when the Enterprise arrives at a planet, her future husband to be has had dreams of a unknown woman for years before meeting her.

title: The Big Goodbye
summary: Captain Picard, Data and Dr. Crusher are trapped in a holodeck program as 1940's detectives during a holdeck malfunction that interferes with a meeting with a alien species that requires the captain only.

title: Datalore
summary: The Enterprise explores Data's home planet, Omicron Theta. They find his brother, and the dark secret he carries.

title: Angel One
summary: An Enterprise away team beams down to a planet with a matriarchal society to search for survivors of a crashed Federation freighter.

At a Federation space station aliens known as the Binars come aboard to upgrade the Enterprises computer and Holographic systems. During this process, the Enterprise is hijacked while Captain Picard and Riker are in the Holodeck.

title: Too Short a Season
summary: A diplomat is requested to mediate a hostage situation and the leader of the world wants the same diplomat that negotiated more than 40 years before. The Admiral who did the negotiations in the past comes on board and starts acting more strangely as time passes.

title: When the Bough Breaks
summary: Inhabitants of an advanced planet, who can no longer reproduce, plan to kidnap children from the Enterprise to rebuild their race.

title: Home Soil
summary: On Velara III, Data and Geordi discover a microscopic creature responsible for the death of an engineer.

title: Coming of Age
summary: Wesley is put to the test as he competes with the other top candidates to get into Starfleet Academy. Meanwhile the Enterprise is put under the scrutiny of a Starfleet officer that seems to be looking for trouble.

title: Heart of Glory
summary: The Enterprise rescues the crew of a damaged vessel in the Neutral zone, discovering several renegade Klingons who decide that they want Lt. Worf to join them.

title: The Arsenal of Freedom
summary: While investigating the disappearance of the star ship Drake, an away team beams down to a strange planet where they received a message about arms sales upon arriving in orbit. Captain Picard and Dr. Crusher vanish during the mission and the Enterprise comes under attack.

title: Symbiosis
summary: When the Enterprise rescues a freighter with engine problems and is being drawn into a planets gravitational field, Picard gets more than he bargained for when it is discovered that the one planets inhabitants may be carrying a disease. The disease causes Picard to consider the Federation's Prime Directive and why it is necessary.

title: Skin of Evil
summary: Deanna is held hostage by a black oil-like alien creature capable of infinite sadism… and infinite power. To save her, one of the Enterprise crew will die.

title: We'll Always Have Paris
summary: Captain Picard reflects on a missed liason at a Paris cafe years in his past when the Enterprise gets a distress call from a scientist who is experimenting with Time rifts and is married to the lady he was supposed to meet in Paris all those years ago.

title: Conspiracy
summary: Spurred by reports of misdeeds in Starfleet's top echelon, Captain Picard heads for Earth to uncover the truth.

title: The Neutral Zone
summary: The Enterprise encounters a ancient capsule containing cryogenically frozen people from 20th Century Earth. Data then brings them on board while the Enterprise is on its way to investigate a series of destroyed Federation outposts at the edge of the Romulan/Federation Neutral zone. The Enterprise soon encounters a Romulan Warbird after the Romulans presence being long absent.

title: The Child
summary: Counselor Deanna Troi announces she is pregnant; the crew sets out to bring a deadly plasma plague to a laboratory.

title: Where Silence Has Lease
summary: A being conducting an experiment traps the Enterprise in a region void of energy and matter.

title: Elementary, Dear Data
summary: Data dons a deerstalker to solve a Sherlock Homes mystery in a holodeck recreation of Victorian London.

title: The Outrageous Okona
summary: A roguish space captain charms all; Data consults a comic about humor.

title: Loud as a Whisper
summary: A deaf mediator's mission to a warring planet is jeopardized when his chorus of interpreters is killed.

title: The Schizoid Man
summary: A brilliant, dying scientist who seeks immortality transfers his mind and knowledge into Data.

title: Unnatural Selection
summary: After discovering a unresponsive federation starship, Dr. Pulaski contracts a disease and starts to age.

title: A Matter of Honor
summary: Commander Riker swaps positions and becomes a temporary first officer on the Klingon ship the Pah. A new crew member of the Enterprise scans the Pagh and discovers a micro lifeform growing on the hull of the ship.

title: The Measure of a Man
summary: Commander Maddox, a scientist who opposed Data's entrance to Stafleet, now wants to dismantle Data in order to study him and create more androids. Data is forced to resign from Starfleet  to avoid a dangerous test.  Captain Picard ends up in a court battle to decide if Data is a lifeform or owned property.

title: The Dauphin
summary: When the Enterprise transports a future leader to another world, a guardian stands between Wesley and a potential love interest.

title: Contagion
summary: When coming to the aid of another Federation ship that is having problems in the Romulan neutral zone, the Enterprise starts having computer problems that leave the ship helpless. Picard believes that the problems may have something to do with a extinct alien race called the Iconians.

title: The Royale
summary: Riker, Worf and Data are trapped in the Hotel Royale and are unable to find their way out.

title: Time Squared
summary: The Enterprise picks up a Star Fleet shuttle floating in space and much to the crew's surprise, another Captain Picard is on board the shuttle. They then learn that the Enterprise is destroyed in a upcoming disaster.

title: The Icarus Factor
summary: Riker is offered a possible command of his own and in the process encounters his estranged father who brings him the news. Lt. Worf starts having emotional issues and Wesley digs into Klingon traditions to discover the cause.

title: Pen Pals
summary: Data makes contact with a alien girl and pen pals with her. He then discovers that her planet is in danger fand she could be killed.

title: Q Who?
summary: After Picard refuses to let Q join the crew, Q hurls the Enterprise into a far quadrant of space where they have a encounter with a unknown cybernetic race. A little bit of Guinan's past is revealed when she senses something is wrong on board Enterprise.

title: Samaritan Snare
summary: Geordi's life is jeopardized when an alien race kidnaps him; Picard is near death with heart complications.

title: Up the Long Ladder
summary: The Enterprise crew encounters a SOS from a lost colony ship and encounters a group of primitive colonists and after assisting them, they encounter the remaining colonists that traveled with them on another world with a unique problem of their own.

title: Manhunt
summary: On her way to a conference, Troi's mother boards the Enterprise and flirts with Picard.

title: The Emissary
summary: Worf's old love, a human-Klingon hybrid, arrives to deal with a shipload of Klingons in cryogenic sleep.

title: Peak Performance
summary: The Ferengi ambush the Enterprise and another vessel during a battle simulation.

title: Shades of Gray
summary: Stardate: 42976.1 - Riker being infected by an alien is used as the basis for a clip show.

title: Evolution
summary: The Enterprise brings eminent scientist Dr. Paul Stubbs to the site of a binary star system, expecting a massive stellar explosion to occur in a few hours. He has waited many years for this event and has devoted his entire life to its study. The Enterprise, however, begins to suffer a series of malfunctions, some minor but others far more serious.

title: The Ensigns of Command
summary: When a alien race demands that a lost human colony is to be evacuated, Data is sent to deal with the issue and has problems convincing the leader of the colony to abandon their homes.

title: The Survivors
summary: Captain Picard and the crew visit a isolate planet that is the home to two people who lived through a devastating attack. Picard then begins to suspect that all is not as it seems when the Enterprise is repeatedly attacked by a unknown ship.

title: Who Watches the Watchers
summary: When a secret Federation observation post is accidentally revealed, a primitive culture ends up worshiping Picard as a god and prepares to sacrifice Troi to appease him.

title: The Bonding
summary: Worf takes responsibility for a boy when his mother, the ships archaeologist is killed on a away mission.

title: Booby Trap
summary: The Enterprise experiences a rapid energy drain that leaves the crew vulnerable to radiation exposure while exploring in a area of space where a alien race once lived.

title: The Enemy
summary: A Romulan warship thwarts attempts to rescue Geordi, stranded on a planet swept by electrical storms.

title: The Price
summary: Troi falls for a handsome delegate who uses underhanded tactics in negotiations.

title: The Vengeance Factor
summary: Picard offers to mediate a dispute between a peaceful society and a renegade clan that steals to live.

title: The Defector
summary: A Romulan defector leads the Enterprise into a confrontation that could erupt into war.

title: The Hunted
summary: A prison escapee claims he is a soldier brainwashed by his goverment to kill.

title: The High Ground
summary: A radical takes Dr. Crusher hostage to treat his injured Comrades.

title: Déjà Q
summary: Picard's nemesis Q, claiming to have lost his powers, appears on the Enterprise.

title: A Matter of Perspective
summary: A widow accuses Riker of seducing her and killing her husband, a respected scientist.

title: Yesterday's Enterprise
summary: An Enterprise from the past breaks through a time rift, altering the course of history.

title: The Offspring
summary: An admiral (Nicolas Coster) wants to remove Data's creation, a female android, from the Enterprise.

title: Sins of the Father
summary: Lt. Worf and his brother Kurn defend their family honor when the Klingon high council accuses their late father of treason.

title: Allegiance
summary: Stardate: 43714.1 Picard is secretly abducted and switched with an alien double. The crews' suspicions are raised when he starts exhibiting unusual behaviour, and is relieved of command.

title: Captain's Holiday
summary: Stardate: 43745.2 While on vacation on Risa, Captain Picard encounters two Vorgons from the 27th Century who claim they are searching for a powerful weapon hidden somewhere on the planet.

title: Tin Man
summary: Stardate: 43779.3 The Enterprise encounters a 'living' ship in the Neutral Zone, and risks breaking the Romulan Federation alliance in order to bring it into contact with a Betazoid emissary.

title: Hollow Pursuits
summary: Stardate: 43807.4 A nervous and insecure officer, Lt. Reginald Barclay, places the Enterprise in great danger when he neglects his duties in Engineering, and instead spends his time acting out his fantasies on the holodeck.

title: The Most Toys
summary: Stardate: 43872.2 The crew are shattered by the apparent death of Data in a shuttle explosion, and are prevented from carrying out a detailed investigation when Starfleet gives them orders for a new mission elsewhere. However, the crew don't realize that he was actually abducted and placed on display as part of a collection of rare and valuable items held by a disreputable character.

title: Sarek
summary: Vulcan ambassador Sarek becomes temperamental while on the Enterprise with his wife.

title: Ménage à Troi
summary: The Ferengi kidnap Riker, Troi and her visiting mother.

title: Transfigurations
summary: The Enterprise crew saves a badly injured humanoid who possesses remarkable powers.

title: The Best of Both Worlds
summary: The Borg advance their plans to assimilate the human race by kidnapping Picard and making him into their spokesman.

title: The Best of Both Worlds Part II
summary: Riker is torn between saving Picard or humanity when the Borg plan to use the abducted captain in their scheme to destroy Earth and turn him into Locutus.

title: Family
summary: Picard meets with his older brother in France, and contemplates resigning his Starfleet commission after his ordeal with the Borg. Worf's adoptive parents spend time with their son on the Enterprise, and succeed in embarrassing him in front of his crewmates.

title: Brothers
summary: While escorting a seriously ill boy to the closest Federation Starbase for treatment, Data mysteriously takes control of the Enterprise and takes it to a distant planet. He learns that his creator has summoned him for an important meeting that could change his life. However, Dr. Soong unknowingly summoned Data's twin brother Lore, into the bargain.

title: Suddenly Human
summary: Picard faces a child-custody dilemma after the Enterprise rescues an orphaned human child.

title: Remember Me
summary: When Doctor Crusher leaps into another dimension of reality, Enterprise crew members mysteriously disappear.

title: Legacy
summary: Tasha Yar's sister helps the Enterprise rescue Federation members held hostage on her planet.

title: Reunion
summary: Worf deals with a personal dilemma, Picard mediates a power struggle between successors to the Klingon Empire.

title: Future Imperfect
summary: After an aborted mission to an uninhabited planet, Riker awakens in the future with no memory of the past 16 years.

title: Final Mission
summary: Wesley goes on one last mission with Captain Picard that jeopardizes the Captains life before going to Starfleet academy.

title: The Loss
summary: Troi loses her empathic sense at the same time the Enterprise encounters a mysterious life form that appears to be heading toward self-destruction.

title: Data's Day
summary: While the USS Enterprise heads towards a secret rendezvous, a friend's upcoming wedding compounds Data's confusion about the nuances of human feelings.

title: The Wounded
summary: Picard and the crew attempt to apprehend a renegade Federation starship that has attacked a Cardassian space station without provocation.

title: Devil's Due
summary: Picard tries to save a terrorized planet and the Enterprise from a woman claiming to be the devil who has returned after 1,000 years to claim the planet as she was promised.

title: Clues
summary: Upon investigating a newly discovered Class M planet, the crew are knocked unconscious. Data claims that they had only lost 30 seconds, but the crew begin to discover clues that Data may be lying about more than just that small detail.

title: First Contact
summary: A first-contact mission puts Riker in an alien hospital, leaving Picard to convince the planet's leaders that the Enterprise poses no threat.

title: Galaxy's Child
summary: After killing an attacking life form, the Enterprise discovers a "baby" within its womb; Geordi meets the object of his admiration, but his overly familiar attitude toward her makes their interactions uncomfortable.

title: Night Terrors
summary: When the Enterprise becomes stuck in an energy-draining rupture in space known as a Tyken's Rift, the crew begins experiencing severe sleep deprivation, but one crew member's recurring dream may provide the solution that saves them all.

title: Identity Crisis
summary: Geordi begins to exhibit signs of mutating into another life form as a result of a parasite picked up on an Away Team mission.

title: The Nth Degree
summary: An alien probe threatens the Enterprise when it emits an energy surge that turns an innocuous crew member into a superhuman.

title: Qpid
summary: Q questions the dispassionate Captain Picard about his relationship with a beautiful archaeologist, but when Picard refuses to give him any satisfactory answers, he transports the crew to Sherwood Forest for a reenactment of the Robin Hood legend.

title: The Drumhead
summary: When an explosion damages the Enterprise's warp engine, a retired Starfleet admiral boards the ship and begins an investigation that ultimately leads her to suspect Captain Picard of participating in a treasonous conspiracy.

title: Half a Life
summary: Lwaxana Troi pays another visit to the Enterprise, where she falls in love with a scientist from Kaelon II, but she is shocked to learn that he must soon return home to participate in a suicide ritual their culture has practiced for generations.

title: The Host
summary: While on a peacekeeping mission to the Peliar system, a Trill ambassador begins a relationship with Dr. Crusher, but when he is injured in a surprise attack, he must confess to the doctor that his body is merely a host for a symbiont..

title: The Mind's Eye
summary: The Romulans brainwash Geordi as part of a plot to drive a wedge between the Federation and the Klingon Empire.

title: In Theory
summary: While the Enterprise explores a nebula with unusual properties, Data becomes involved with a crew member.

title: Redemption
summary: Part 1 of 2. Picard tries to keep the Federation neutral when the Klingon Empire faces civil war; Lt. Worf struggles with divided loyalties.

title: Redemption II
summary: Part 2 of 2: Suspecting Romulan interference, Picard gets involved in the Klingon civil war.

title: Darmok
summary: Picard encounters the leader of a civilization which communicates only in metaphor.

title: Ensign Ro
summary: A Starfleet admiral, unwittingly being used by outside forces, involves the Enterprise crew in a deadly conspiracy.

title: Silicon Avatar
summary: When the Crystalline Entitiy reappears, Picard and Data try to establish communication with it before it is destroyed by a vengeful scientist.

title: Disaster
summary: A natural force damages the Enterprise, trapping Picard and forcing Troi to act as captain.

title: The Game
summary: The Enterprise gets a surprise visit from Starfleet Academy Cadet Wesley Crusher, who discovers something alien and sinister controlling the crew.

title: Unification I
summary: Picard and Data follow Spock on an unauthorized mission to Romulus.

title: Unification II
summary: Spock proceeds with his quest for the reunification of Vulcan and Romulans even though he and Picard are suspicious of Romulan motives.

title: A Matter of Time
summary: As the Enterprise crew struggles to save Penthara IV following an asteroid collision, a historian from the 26th century arrives on board.

title: New Ground
summary: When Worf's mother tells him that his son's Earth parents can no longer care for him, Worf tries to be a father to his child, Alexander.

title: Hero Worship
summary: When a Starfleet ship crashes inside a thick, black cloud, Data attempts to coax the traumatised young sole survivor into revealing what exactly happened.

title: Violations
summary: Several crew members suffer violent hallucinations and comas as alien researchers visit the ship.

title: The Masterpiece Society
summary: The Enterprise tries to save a "perfect" colony from destruction, but the assistance causes damage of its own.

title: Conundrum
summary: When an alien ship crosses the Enterprise's path, its strong scanners cause all of the crew members to completely lose their memories

title: Power Play
summary: The Enterprise crew discovers a Federation starship missing for 200 years. However, Troi, O'Brien and Data find themselves haunted by demons on board.

title: Ethics
summary: When he loses the ability to walk after an accident in the Cargo bay, a traumatised Worf asks Riker to assist him in a Klingon suicide ritual.

title: The Outcast
summary: Riker finds himself falling for a Gennai when the two races collaborate on a mission to investigate the mysterious disappearance of a shuttle.

title: Cause and Effect
summary: The future of the Enterprise looks bleak when the ship gets trapped in a time warp, causing the crew members to continually repeat their experience.

title: The First Duty
summary: When Wesley Crusher's team suffers an accident at Starfleet Academy, Picard helps investigate its cause, and believes a cover-up is taking place.

title: Cost of Living
summary: As the ship encounters mechanical problems, Lwaxana Troi takes Worf's son under her wing while she prepares for her wedding.

title: The Perfect Mate
summary: Picard finds himself attracted to a beautiful woman being given as a gift to promote reconciliation between two warring systems.

title: Imaginary Friend
summary: While exploring a rare nebula around a neutron star, the Enterprise's safety is threatened by a little girl's imaginary playmate.

title: I, Borg
summary: An encounter with a injured adolescent Borg gives Picard the opportunity to remove the Borg threat forever.

title: The Next Phase
summary: Geordi and Ro disappear and are presumed dead after a transporting maneuver from a disabled Romulan science ship goes awry.

title: The Inner Light
summary: Picard awakens after being hit by a mysterious particle stream from a type of probe/satellite the ship discovered, to find he is living another life on a strange planet.

title: Time's Arrow
summary: Data is transported back in time to 19th century San Francisco, where he hopes to solve the mystery of his death after a Enterprise away team finds Data's head buried in a cave.

title: Time's Arrow, Part II
summary: The away team after encountering Mark Twain and Guinan in the 19th century, try to solve the mystery of who and what alien is killing people in 19th century San Francisco.

title: Realm of Fear
summary: A skittish member of Geordi's engineering staff encounters a bizarre creature while in the process of transporting from another ship.

title: Man of the People
summary: A visiting ambassador conceals the deadly secret to his successful negotiations as he attempts to use Troi to further is reputation.

title: Relics
summary: The Enterprise discovers a Dyson Sphere, in the process they discover a disabled ship that still has a crew member on board. When beaming over to the ship, Jordi discovers Montgomery "Scottie" Scott in the transporter system of the ship.

title: Schisms
summary: Adjustments to the subspace sensor array inadvertently establish a link to aliens who begin kidnapping crew members for experiments.

title: True Q
summary: A young honor student serving aboard the Enterprise is torn between remaining a part of the crew or accepting an offer made by Q.

title: Rascals
summary: Picard, Guinan, Ro and Keiko experience trouble aboard their shuttlecraft and transport back to the Enterprise...as 12 year old children.

title: A Fistful of Datas
summary: After a computer malfunction,Worf, his son Alexander Rozhenko, and Counselor Deanna Troi are trapped in an Old West holodeck program wherein the interactive characters physically resemble and have the same enhanced abilities as Data.

title: The Quality of Life
summary: Data discovers a group of robots that he believes qualify as lifeforms.

title: Chain of Command, Part I
summary: Picard, Worf, and Dr. Crusher are reassigned from the Enterprise to a secret mission. Meanwhile, the Enterprise is under the command of Captain Edward Jellico, who immediately starts making changes, much to the dismay of the crew.

title: Chain of Command, Part II
summary: Captain Picard's secret mission fails, leading to him being captured by Cardassians. As he is tortured by his captors, Captain Jellico and theEnterpriseattempt to prevent war with the Cardassian Union.

title: Ship in a Bottle
summary: Data is playing Sherlock Holmes on the Holodeck, a glitch appears and Lt. Barclay is called to investigate and he discovers protected Holodeck files. Professor Moriarty is then released and demands to see Captain Picard. Against the laws of physics, Moriarty is able to leave the Holodeck and takes control of the Enterprise.

title: Aquiel
summary: A Starfleet Lieutenant and a Klingon officer is implicated in the murder of the missing starfleet officer on a remote relay station. One of the shuttlecraft's is missing as well. Aquiel Uhnari is befriended by Geordi after he reads her personal logs during the investigation.

title: Face of the Enemy
summary: Troi wakes up as a Romulan intelligence officer much to her surprise. She then finds out that it is part of a elaborate scheme for Romulan dissident's to defect.

title: Tapestry
summary: Picard is near death and Q makes him relive a tragedy from his Starfleet Academy days.

title: Birthright, Part I
summary: Data is zapped by a energy stream and has strange memories from during the time he was out. Worf hears a story that his father may not have died on Khitomer but may still be alive on a planet near the Romulan neutral zone.

title: Birthright, Part II
summary: Data explores the experience he had while zapped, Worf is held prisoner by Romulans with the Khitomer survivors.

title: Starship Mine
summary: Captain Picard and a desperate gang of thieves are trapped on board the Enterprise while the ship is being swept with deadly baryon rays to remove radiation the ship has absorbed over time.

title: Lessons
summary: Picard becomes intrigued and then involved with a brilliant new crew member, creating complications when a potentially deadly mission arises.

title: The Chase
summary: The death of Picards archaeology professor results in a tantalizing mystery involving Klingons, Cardassians and Romulans.

title: Frame of Mind
summary: On a secret mission to a troubled planet, Riker questions his mental stability after experiencing a series of confusing vignettes.

title: Suspicions
summary: The death of a pioneering Ferengi scientist ebroils Dr. Crusher in a mystery that may end her Starfleet career.

title: Rightful Heir
summary: Warrior Kahless returns from death to reclaim the Klingon empire.

title: Second Chances
summary: Riker returns to the site of a 8-year old mission, to retrieve important research data and is unnerved to encounter his identical twin.

title: Timescape
summary: When returning to the Enterprise, Picard, Data, Troi and Geordi find that the Enterpise is frozen in time with a Romulan ship and in the middle of a core breach.

title: Descent, Part I
summary: Data experiences anger for the first time during a Borg attack that differs from previous encounters.  Picard and the crew try to track the Borg down while Data attempts to recreate the emotion.

title: Descent, Part II
summary: Imprisoned by the Borg and cut off from his ship, Picard, Troi and LaForge attempt to break Lore's hold on Data. Meanwhile, Dr. Crusher tries to beam up all the search parties on the planet while eluding a Borg ship.

title: Liaisons
summary: A cultural exchange teams Worf with an obnoxious ambassador and strands Picard with a woman who seems to be obsessed with him.

title: Interface
summary: In defiance of Picard's orders, Geordi uses a risky procedure in an effort to find and save his missing mother.

title: Gambit, Part I
summary: Captain Picard infiltrates a smuggling ring that is searching for Romulan artifacts.

title: Gambit, Part II
summary: Captain Picard and commander Riker pose as enemies in order to retrieve a deadly artifact.

title: Phantasms
summary: The crew helps Data investigate when his dream program begins suddenly generating nightmares. Meanwhile, Picard attempts to avoid attending a boring Starfleet banquet.

title: Dark Page
summary: Lwaxana Troi visits the Enterprise, but she's preoccupied by a dark secret she has carried for years.

title: Attached
summary: After escaping imprisonment on an alien world, Picard and Beverly find that their thoughts are connected by brain implants.

title: Force of Nature
summary: The crew is shocked when an alien brother and sister sneak on board and claim their planet is being destroyed by the Enterprise's warp drive.

title: Inheritance
summary: During a mission to save an endangered planet, Data is stunned when he meets a native scientist who claims to be his estranged mother.

title: Parallels
summary: After Worf returns from a bat'leth tournament, he is the only person who notices subtle changes on theEnterprise.

title: The Pegasus
summary: Riker's loyalties are tested when he is reunited with his former captain, Pressman, now Admiral, of the missing ship Pegasus.

title: Homeward
summary: Worf's brother violates the Prime Directive in order to save an alien race whose existence is threatened when violent storms bombard their planet.

title: Sub Rosa
summary: Dr Crusher is shocked to come across a family secret when she attends her grandmothers funeral.

title: Lower Decks
summary: Four young officers become embroiled in a secret - and potentially dangerous - mission as they vie for promotion.

title: Thine Own Self
summary: Data trails a probe which has crashed on to a primitive planet. But when he crashes too, he finds himself unable to remember anything prior to the event.

title: Masks
summary: Picard discovers that an 87-million-years-old comet has been housing alien beings, which attack both Data and the Enterprise' computer systems.

title: Eye of the Beholder
summary: A suicide on the Enterprise leaves the crew stunned by the loss. Meanwhile, Deanna and Worf begin to form a relationship.

title: Genesis
summary: Picard and Data brave going into an asteroid field when a new torpedo's guidance system malfunctions. Meanwhile, the crew begin to act strangely.

title: Journey's End
summary: When the Federation gives the Cardassians access to a planet inhabited by Native American Indians, Picard has the unenviable task of trying to relocate them.

title: Firstborn
summary: Alexander must face his first rite of ascension initiation, during which a Klingon warrior named K'Mtar has a disturbing request for him.

title: Bloodlines
summary: Captain Picard battles to rescue his son from a vengeful Ferengi whose own son was killed by Picard during the Battle of Maxia.

title: Emergence
summary: The computer systems on board the Enterprise begin experiencing repeated malfunctions, leading the crew to suspect that the ship itself may be evolving.

title: Preemptive Strike
summary: When Ro is assigned to infiltrate the Maquis, she finds herself sympathising with their plight, forcing her to choose between her divided loyalties.

title: All Good Things... (1)
summary: Captain Picard finds himself travelling between the past, present and future, but discovers he may be responsible for the end of mankind.

title: All Good Things... (2)
summary: In the second of the two-part series finale, Picard continues his race against time to try and end the threat to the future of mankind.
